items.body: Disc pressure, poor posture and long hours seated are the most common causes of lumbar pain. We combine adjustments, decompression and targeted acupuncture to release the nerve and rebuild support.

items.title: Mid Back & Ribs
items.body: Thoracic restriction shows up as stiffness, shallow breathing and a burning ache between the shoulder blades. Mobilization plus soft-tissue work restores rotation and comfort.

items.title: Shoulders & Arms
items.body: Rotator cuff strain, frozen shoulder and numbness down the arm usually trace back to the neck. We treat both ends of the chain so the relief actually lasts.

items.title: Head & Neck
items.body: Tension headaches, migraines and jaw pain respond remarkably well to cervical adjustments combined with acupuncture points that calm the nervous system.

story.title: Two Traditions, One Treatment Plan
story.body:
Nguyen Chiropractic and Acupuncture Wellness was founded on a simple observation: patients get better faster when structural care and energetic care work together. Our clinic was designed around that idea. A chiropractic adjustment restores the mechanics of the spine; acupuncture calms the nervous system and improves circulation so the correction holds. Together they shorten recovery and reduce the chance that the pain returns.

We keep our schedule intentionally light so no appointment feels rushed. You will always know what we found, what we are doing about it, and how long it should take.

services.title: Chiropractic Adjustment
services.excerpt: Precise, gentle corrections that restore joint motion and take pressure off irritated nerves.
services.body: An adjustment is a controlled, specific force applied to a joint that has lost normal motion. Restoring that motion reduces nerve irritation, relaxes the muscles guarding the area and lets inflammation drain. We use hands-on and instrument-assisted techniques, and we always choose the gentlest option that will do the job.

services.title: Acupuncture
services.excerpt: Fine, sterile needles placed to calm pain signals, reduce inflammation and improve circulation.
services.body: Acupuncture is one of the most studied drug-free treatments for chronic pain. Needles the width of a hair are placed at specific points to trigger your body's own pain-relief chemistry. Most patients feel deeply relaxed during the session and notice a change in symptoms within three to five visits.

services.title: Spinal Decompression
services.excerpt: Gentle traction that relieves disc pressure — a non-surgical option for herniation and sciatica.
services.body: Decompression uses a computer-controlled table to create negative pressure inside the disc, drawing bulging material inward and pulling water and nutrients back in. It is comfortable, requires no recovery time, and is often the difference between managing sciatica and resolving it.

services.title: Massage Therapy
services.excerpt: Deep tissue and trigger-point work that prepares the body for adjustment and holds it there.
services.body: Muscles are what hold a correction in place. Our therapists release the tight bands and trigger points that keep pulling joints out of position, which means fewer visits and longer-lasting relief. Sessions are tailored from light lymphatic work to deep clinical pressure.

services.title: Cupping Therapy
services.excerpt: Suction that lifts tissue, increases blood flow and frees fascia that stretching cannot reach.
services.body: Where massage compresses, cupping decompresses. The suction separates layers of fascia that have become stuck together, flooding the area with fresh blood. It is especially effective for stubborn upper-back tension, athletic recovery and long-standing scar tissue.

services.title: Sports Injury Rehab
services.excerpt: Return-to-play programs that rebuild strength and mechanics, not just calm the pain down.
services.body: Sprains, strains and overuse injuries need three things: settle the inflammation, restore the motion, then rebuild the strength through full range. We progress you through each phase with clear benchmarks so you know exactly when it is safe to compete again.

services.title: Auto Accident Injury
services.excerpt: Whiplash and soft-tissue care with the documentation your insurance claim requires.
services.body: Whiplash symptoms often appear days after a collision, when the adrenaline fades. Early treatment prevents scar tissue from setting in the wrong pattern. We examine, treat and document thoroughly, and we coordinate directly with attorneys and insurers when needed.

services.title: Prenatal Chiropractic
services.excerpt: Pregnancy-safe techniques for pelvic balance, lower-back comfort and easier delivery.
services.body: As the body changes through pregnancy, the pelvis and lower back carry the load. Using specialized tables and low-force techniques, we keep the pelvis balanced, relieve round-ligament and sciatic pain, and help create the room baby needs.

posts.author: Dr. Nguyen
posts.title: Five Desk Habits That Quietly Cause Back Pain
posts.excerpt: Most of the lumbar pain we treat is built one workday at a time. Here is what to change first.
posts.body:
Sitting is not the enemy — sitting still is. The spine feeds its discs through movement, and eight uninterrupted hours in a chair starves them.

Start with your monitor. If the top of the screen sits below eye level, your head drifts forward, and every inch forward adds roughly ten pounds of load to your neck and upper back. Raise it.

Next, your feet. Crossed legs tilt the pelvis and rotate the lumbar spine for hours at a time. Keep both feet flat, hips slightly above knees.

Third, the armrests. Arms unsupported means the shoulders hang from the neck muscles all day. Set the rests so your elbows land naturally at ninety degrees.

Fourth, the wallet. A thick wallet in a back pocket lifts one side of the pelvis every time you sit. It sounds trivial; we correct the resulting imbalance constantly.

Finally, set a timer. Standing and walking for two minutes every half hour does more for disc health than any chair on the market.

posts.author: Marcus Lee, L.Ac.
posts.title: What Acupuncture Actually Does to Pain
posts.excerpt: No mysticism required. Here is the physiology behind why the needles work.
posts.body:
When a needle enters tissue at an acupuncture point, three measurable things happen. Local circulation increases, which flushes inflammatory chemicals out of the area. The spinal cord releases endorphins and enkephalins, your body's own opioids. And the brain's pain-processing centers reduce their activity, which imaging studies have repeatedly confirmed.

That is why acupuncture is most effective for conditions where the nervous system has become oversensitive: chronic low back pain, migraines, neuropathy and tension that returns as soon as you leave the treatment table.

A typical course is six to eight sessions, close together at first. Most people feel something shift by the third visit. If nothing has changed by the fifth, we say so and change the plan.

posts.author: Sarah Kim, D.C.
posts.title: How to Sleep When Your Neck Hurts
posts.excerpt: The right pillow height, the position to avoid, and why mornings are the worst.
posts.body:
You spend a third of your life in one position, so it matters more than any single exercise.

If you sleep on your back, the pillow should fill the curve behind your neck without pushing your head forward. If you sleep on your side, it should be thick enough to keep your nose in line with the center of your chest. Stomach sleeping is the one position we ask patients to give up: it holds the neck rotated for hours.

Mornings hurt most because discs rehydrate overnight and are at their fullest right when you wake. Give yourself five minutes of gentle movement before lifting anything, and never bend forward to brush your teeth or tie your shoes in that first hour.

faqs.q: How many visits will I need?
faqs.a: It depends on how long the problem has been there. Acute issues often resolve in two to four visits; chronic conditions usually need six to twelve. You will get an estimated plan after your exam.

faqs.q: What happens on my first visit?
faqs.a: A consultation and full exam, including posture and range of motion. If treatment is appropriate the same day, we will begin. Plan for about 45 minutes.
Yes, with pregnancy-specific tables and low-force techniques. Prenatal care is one of the most common reasons patients come to us.

products.title: Cervical Support Pillow
products.excerpt: Holds the natural curve of the neck so the adjustment you received holds overnight.
products.body:
The pillow we recommend most often. Contoured memory foam keeps the cervical spine in neutral whether you sleep on your back or your side, which is where most morning neck pain is created.

Removable bamboo cover, machine washable. Two heights available in clinic — we will check which one matches your shoulder width before you buy.

products.title: Lumbar Support Cushion
products.excerpt: Turns any office or car seat into one that supports the lower back properly.
products.body:
Eight hours in a chair without lumbar support flattens the natural curve of the lower spine and loads the discs. This cushion restores that curve with a firm foam core and an adjustable strap that keeps it in place.

Fits most office chairs and car seats. Especially useful for patients we are treating for sciatica or disc pressure.

products.title: Hot & Cold Therapy Pack
products.excerpt: One pack for both phases of recovery — cold for inflammation, heat for stiffness.
products.body:
Freeze it for the first 48 hours after a flare-up to control inflammation, microwave it afterwards to relax guarded muscle. The gel stays flexible when frozen so it wraps around the neck, shoulder or low back instead of sitting on top.

Comes with a soft sleeve so it never touches the skin directly.

products.title: High-Density Foam Roller
products.excerpt: The at-home tool we prescribe most for thoracic mobility and tight hips.
products.body:
Most of the home exercises we assign for mid-back stiffness and hip tightness use a roller. This one is high-density EVA so it keeps its shape for years instead of softening after a few months.

18 inches — long enough to roll across the spine, short enough to travel with. We will show you the exact drills for your case at your next visit.

products.title: Herbal Relief Balm
products.excerpt: Traditional Chinese herbal formula for sore muscles and stiff joints, drug free.
products.body:
A warming topical based on a classical liniment formula — camphor, menthol and herbal extracts that increase local circulation and calm surface pain. We use it in the treatment room after massage and cupping.

Non-greasy, absorbs in under a minute. Safe to use several times a day.

products.title: Resistance Band Kit
products.excerpt: Three tension levels covering every rehab progression we assign between visits.
products.body:
Rebuilding strength is what keeps pain from coming back, and almost every program we write can be done with bands. The kit includes light, medium and heavy loops plus a door anchor and a printed card of the core exercises.

Latex free, so it is safe for patients with a latex sensitivity.
